text: Enables the debug mode for TotoWar mods.\\n\\n[[img:totowar_alert]][[/img]][[col:red]]THIS HEAVILY IMPACTS THE GAME PERFORMANCES ! ONLY ACTIVATE THIS OPTION WHEN NEEDED.[[/col]]\\n\\nDebug mode stores a lot of detailed debug logs for TotoWar mods.\\n\\nLogs are stored in the [[col:alliance_ally]]totowar_logs.txt[[/col]] file in your game folder.\\nUseful when you need to report a bug in order to be able to figure out what is happening.\\n\\n[[col:alliance_ally]]Unchecked[[/col]] by default.
